title: scenario
description: EchoForge scenario document. Binds a sensor archetype to a set of object cards in a named environment with a deterministic random seed, defining a reproducible simulation setup. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic ids, explicit provenance, license, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1, computed from the identity field tuple.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; must be the literal string "scenario".

schema_version.description: Schema contract version this document conforms to (currently pinned to 1.0.0).

public_proxy_id.description: Slug identifying the public proxy this scenario is derived from (lowercase, dot/underscore/hyphen separated).

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: source kind, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) governing use of this document.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and per-check results.

scenario_name.description: Human-readable name of the scenario (e.g. "urban_intersection_xband_v1"); non-empty string.

sensor_archetype_id.description: Deterministic id of the referenced sensor_archetype document.

object_card_ids.description: Ordered list of deterministic ids of object_card documents participating in this scenario; at least one entry required.

seed.description: Deterministic random seed (u64) used to make scenario instantiation reproducible; non-negative integer.
